title: Toolchain currency: claude-flow
requirement: Installed claude-flow must equal the registry latest.

execution.command_template: test -n "$(bun info 'claude-flow' version 2>/dev/null)" && test "$(bun info 'claude-flow' version 2>/dev/null)" = "$(bun pm ls -g 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'claude\-flow@[0-9][^ ]*' | head -1 | sed 's/.*@//')"

note: Bun's global root is in the XDG_RUNTIME_DIR tmpfs on this host; a missing or outdated global package can reflect a prior install that evaporated after reboot. This probe made no changes.
